dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます
dialogue.English: We'll begin now that it's time.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ。成立してますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. Are we connected?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いいたしますはじめにあなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんばんは　28歳女性です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a 28-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談なのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 職場のことで
dialogue.English: It's about my workplace.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 話していいんですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay to talk about it?

dialogue.content: はいどのようなことにお悩みなのでしょう
dialogue.English: Yes, please tell me what's on your mind.

dialogue.content: 先週まで入院していたのですが、コロナにかかった訳じゃないのに、なんかみんなよそよそしくて嫌だなと思っています。
dialogue.English: I was hospitalized until last week, and even though it wasn't COVID, everyone at work seems distant, and it's making me uncomfortable.

dialogue.content: 先週まで入院されていらっしゃったのですねこの時期に大変でしょうね。コロナではないのによそよそしいのは嫌ですね
dialogue.English: So you were hospitalized until last week. That must have been difficult, especially at a time like this. It must feel awful for them to be so distant even though it wasn't COVID.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場の方からは何か声掛けとかございましたでしょうか
dialogue.English: Did anyone at your workplace reach out or say anything to you?

dialogue.content: ご病気のことで
dialogue.English: About your illness.

dialogue.content: 上司に声をかけて自席で仕事をして帰ってきました。
dialogue.English: I greeted my boss, worked at my desk, and then went home.

dialogue.content: 職場の人とは話をしていません
dialogue.English: I haven't talked to anyone else at work.

dialogue.content: 12月が忙しいので、この時期の入院でめいわくはかけていないとおもうのです。
dialogue.English: December is a busy month, so I don't think my hospitalization caused much inconvenience.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。コロナでは無いのにそのような雰囲気だと気持ちが滅入りますよね…
dialogue.English: I see. It must be disheartening to face that kind of atmosphere, especially when it wasn't even COVID...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: せっかく退院されたのになんか落ち込んでしまいますよね。そのときどんな風に感じましたか
dialogue.English: You just got out of the hospital, and yet you're left feeling down. How did that make you feel at that moment?

dialogue.content: どんなお気持ちでしたか
dialogue.English: What feelings came up for you?

dialogue.content: その時とはどの時ですか？
dialogue.English: What moment are you referring to?

dialogue.content: 復帰したあとよそよそしい態度をを感じた時などいかがでしたか
dialogue.English: For example, when you sensed their distant attitude after returning to work—how was that for you?

dialogue.content: 嫌な感じと書きました。
dialogue.English: I already said it felt unpleasant.

dialogue.content: ずっと自席にいらっしゃるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you mostly stay at your desk?

dialogue.content: はい。仕事ですから。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's work, after all.

dialogue.content: 同じ部署の方はどれくらいいらっしゃるのでしょう。上司以外と接触はないのでしょうか
dialogue.English: How many people are in your department? Do you have contact with anyone other than your boss?

dialogue.content: はい。3回建ての自社ビルで働いています。人は20人くらいが時間差で働いています。
dialogue.English: Yes. I work in a three-story, company-owned building. There are about 20 people working staggered shifts.

dialogue.content: 基本お昼のお弁当買いに行く時くらいですかね。話をするのは。
dialogue.English: I guess the only time I really talk to people is when I go out to buy lunch.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。時間差で働かれていらっしゃるのですね。お昼休みぐらいなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you work staggered shifts. And you only talk around lunchtime.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 病気になったのはしかたないのに、よそよそしい態度をは辛くなりますよね
dialogue.English: It's hard when people are distant, especially since you couldn't help getting sick.

dialogue.content: 仕方なくはないですけどね
dialogue.English: I wouldn’t say it was unavoidable, though.

dialogue.content: 生物は気をつけて食べないととは思っています。
dialogue.English: I do think I need to be careful with raw foods.

dialogue.content: そうですね。なろうと思ってなったわけではないですよね
dialogue.English: Right. It's not like you intended to get sick, is it?

dialogue.content: 食当たりですか
dialogue.English: Was it food poisoning?

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it was.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お腹も痛いし気分も落ち込みますね
dialogue.English: I see. The stomach pain must have been awful, and it's depressing, too.

dialogue.content: 嫌な雰囲気はどれくらい続いていらっしゃるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: How long has that uncomfortable atmosphere been going on?

dialogue.content: もうお腹は痛くありません。
dialogue.English: My stomach doesn't hurt anymore.

dialogue.content: 痛くなくてよかったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear it doesn't hurt anymore.

dialogue.content: 今日からです。
dialogue.English: It started today.

dialogue.content: 今日復帰されたのですね。それでよそよそしい感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: Oh, so you returned to work today. And that's when you felt they were being distant.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普通は、大丈夫だった？とか声かけてくれてもいいのに、と思いました。
dialogue.English: I thought that normally, someone would at least ask, “Are you okay now?” or something.

dialogue.content: 声掛けがなかったのですね。それは淋しく感じたでしょうね…
dialogue.English: So no one checked in with you. That must have felt lonely...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。一声かけて欲しいですね。普段はどのようなご関係でしょうか
dialogue.English: I understand. You just want them to say something, to show a little concern. What is your relationship with your colleagues usually like?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場の同僚ですが
dialogue.English: They're my colleagues.

dialogue.content: 入院中も誰もお見舞いに来れないし、(コロナ禍なので面会禁止)
dialogue.English: No one could visit me while I was in the hospital, either, since visitation is prohibited because of COVID.

dialogue.content: なんか、寂しい世の中だなと思います。
dialogue.English: It just makes me feel like the world is a lonely place.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今は関係が希薄に感じられますよね…
dialogue.English: I agree. Relationships can feel so fragile these days...

dialogue.content: 相談員さんも、先週入院していたと私が言っても、体調大丈夫ですか？とおっしゃらなかったですよ。
dialogue.English: You know, when I told you I was hospitalized last week, you didn't ask if I was feeling okay, either.

dialogue.content: ごねんなさいね。体調のことも思ったのですが…いまどんなお気持ちなのかと気になりました。入院中も淋しく感じたのではないでしょうか。ベットでどんなことを思いました。
dialogue.English: I'm very sorry. I was thinking about your physical health, but I was more focused on how you are feeling emotionally right now. I imagine you must have felt lonely in the hospital as well. What were you thinking about while you were lying in bed?

dialogue.content: 職場の方とは、普段から、仲良くしているわけではないですが、決して仲が悪いわけではありません。
dialogue.English: I'm not particularly close with my coworkers, but we're not on bad terms by any means.

dialogue.content: ただ、心配してもらえなかったので、なんかよそよそしくて見えただけかもしれません。
dialogue.English: It might just be that because no one showed any concern, it seemed to me like they were being distant.

dialogue.content: けど、なんだか普通に過ごされるのって寂しいと思いました。
dialogue.English: Still, I felt lonely seeing everyone just go about things as usual.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そうですよね。やはり一言何か欲しいと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, I understand. You just want someone to say something, even a single word.

dialogue.content: こんな時期だからコロナじゃないことを会社にきちんと報告しといたので、大丈夫？と言ってもらえると思ってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I had properly reported to the company that it wasn't COVID, especially given the times we're in, so I thought someone would ask me if I was okay.

dialogue.content: けど、仲良くしていない人に声なんて、わざわざかけませんよね
dialogue.English: But then again, you wouldn't go out of your way to talk to someone you're not close with, would you?

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは、職場の人が休んだら声かけますか？
dialogue.English: Counselor, would you say something to a coworker who returned to work after an absence?

dialogue.content: いえでも一言欲しいとおもいます。復帰されたら声掛けは致しますが知らなければ声を掛けないかのしれません
dialogue.English: I understand wanting someone to say something. I would certainly say something to a coworker when they returned, though I might not if I didn't know they had been away.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。時間差で働いているから、今思えば、私が入院してたことすら知らない人もいたかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Since we work staggered shifts, now that I think about it, some people might not have even known I was hospitalized.

dialogue.content: 上司の方しか報告が上がっていない可能性もあると思います
dialogue.English: It's also possible that only your boss was formally notified.

dialogue.content: 知ってても食あたりだから、馬鹿馬鹿しいですよね
dialogue.English: Even if they did know, it was just food poisoning, so it probably seems trivial to them, right?

dialogue.content: 病気なら心配されたかもですね
dialogue.English: If it had been a more serious illness, maybe they would have been concerned.

dialogue.content: そんなことないですよ。でも病気ではなくても入院されたのに
dialogue.English: I don't think that's true. You were still hospitalized, even if it wasn't a more serious illness.

dialogue.content: 時間差でですし、いま気を使って何も情報を上げないところもあると思いますが
dialogue.English: And with the staggered shifts, I think some workplaces are very careful these days not to share personal information.

dialogue.content: 今後も、適当な距離を持って人付き合いをしようと思います
dialogue.English: From now on, I think I'll just keep an appropriate distance in my relationships with people.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for the consultation today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそお話して頂いてありがとうございます。お時間ですが宜しいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me. Our time is just about up, is that okay?

dialogue.content: 少しは気持ちを話せたでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Were you able to share some of what you were feeling?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。では終了させて頂きます
dialogue.English: Thank you. We'll end the session here.

dialogue.content: (カウンセラー役さんお疲れ様でした！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work in the counselor role!)

dialogue.content: 何か質問はありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any questions?

dialogue.content: 本日はクライエント役ありがとうございました。返信遅くてすみません
dialogue.English: Thank you for playing the client role today. I’m sorry for the late replies.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、頑張ってくださいねークライエントの設定等は追って評価に載せさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Not at all, keep up the good work! I'll include the client's background settings and other details in the evaluation later.

dialogue.content: どのような気持ちかわかりませんでしたありがとうございました。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I couldn't quite grasp the emotions involved, but thank you very much. I look forward to your feedback.

dialogue.content: では終了させて頂きます
dialogue.English: I will end the session now.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.English: Thank you for your hard work!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
